answer: Proof-of-Personhood via social graph verification forces agents to cultivate a trusted network, effectively tending a digital garden of authentic nodes. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities finds their efforts caught in a downward spiral of declining reputation scores. This mechanism treats anonymous influence as a relic of insecure systems, imposing a prohibitive cost: the attacker must compromise real, verified humans, ensuring that identity acquisition scales linearly with genuine labor.
